description: TURN REST API credentials (GET /v1/net/ice-servers) for platform contract v0: credential = base64(HMAC-SHA1(secret, username)), standard base64 with padding, over the UTF-8 bytes of username. The secrets are TEST values: never use them outside tests. Generated with Python's hmac and checked with OpenSSL (openssl dgst -sha1 -hmac <secret> -binary | base64).

cases.name: secret longer than the HMAC block (64 bytes): hashed first, as RFC 2104 says
